raw: {"contentVerdict":"DEFECT","defectClass":"reused narrative machinery / structural template reuse","severity":"MATERIAL","shouldBlock":true,"evidenceSpans":["Brisa steadies a clipboard with loose waiver forms at Thursday 6:05 p.m. in the mirrored lobby of Vale Dance, assistant instructor, with rosin dust on the floor.","Dima touches a crooked hospital badge at Monday 6:58 a.m. in the cardiac ICU locker room, new attending, with steam on the mirror.","Brisa starts to defend the audition list.","Dima has a reply ready about protocol","Brisa she must answer the hurt without pretending she knows the parent's motive.","Dima he must decide whether to defend his identity or check the order like a doctor who can learn."],"rationale":"The two examples use the same narrative machinery with topic nouns swapped: each opens with a named character physically handling a role-symbol object, pins the scene to an exact weekday/time and reflective institutional room, adds a job-role label plus sensory surface detail, introduces a challenge from another person, gives the protagonist an immediate defensive response, then reframes the issue as an inner discipline choice expressed in the same awkward final construction.
